A [[Gender/Legends|male]] being was a '''functionary''' in [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] office in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. He discovered that [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] intended to buy a [[packet of information]] from a [[Sei Taria's contact|person]] in a [[Trade Federation brokerage house]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], and that she was to send [[Sei Taria's troubleshooters|her team of "troubleshooters,"]] who would pay the contact with rare coins. This functionary secretly reported this mission to Taria's enemies in exchange for personal profit.

Taria's enemies then killed her contact and framed and tracked the troubleshooters. The trackers used sensors to home in on the rare metals in the coins. The troubleshooters escaped and returned to Coruscant, where the functionary's crime was discovered.
